product.name: Regular Fit Wool-Blend Jacket
product.description: Regular-fit jacket in a felted wool blend with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Collar, buttons at front, and yoke at back. Patch front pockets, an inner pocket, and a straight-cut hem. Lined.
